headline: UFC 333 -- Alexander Volkanovski vs. Movsar Evloev: Fight card, date, odds, location and more
author: Brent Brookhouse

paragraphs.text: Oct 24, 2026 at 10:41 am ET • 2 min read
One of the best fights cards of the year is set for Saturday in Abu Dhabi. UFC heads to the U.A.E. for UFC 333, headlined by a pair of really intriguing and evenly matched title fights.

In the main event, Alexander Volkanovski will look to continue his second reign as featherweight champion when he faces top contender Movsar Evloev. Evloev brings a perfect 20-0 professional record to the Octagon against a legend who has looked ageless in his second run with the title.

It seemed like a foregone conclusion that Merab Dvalishvili would beat Petr Yan for a second time last December. Dvalishvili had already been anointed as the best bantamweight ever by the wider MMA community. Defeating Yan to achieve a record-setting fourth title defense in one year was supposed to be his crowning achievement. Yan had other plans, defying oddsmakers and closing the longest gap between two undisputed UFC title reigns from any male fighter in history. Now, the defending champion is ready to break "The Machine" again and conclude their trilogy.
Instead, Yan won three in a row to earn a rematch with Dvalishvili, this time pulling off an impressive win to capture the championship for a second time.
